notes: «وبهذا الاسناد» takes over the whole chain of the previous report (number 58), so its six names are written as inherited in order; «(رحمه الله)» is a gloss; the Imam is named in the words after the chain («قال الصادق جعفر بن محمد»), so he is the last link as imam_in_text; «(عليهما السلام)» is a blessing
